name: S3 Any Viewer
description: Open any S3 object in a rich in-browser viewer (CSV tables, JSON trees, Parquet, XLSX, XML, images, PDF, and more) instead of downloading it. No AWS keys required.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; object-src 'self'; frame-src 'self' blob:; img-src 'self' blob: data:; media-src 'self' blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'
